description: Direct-to-consumer product selling platform. Industry brain defines what is sold and the visual world. This core defines how the shopping experience works.

three_js.description: Clean geometric shapes — icosahedrons and torus wireframes — rotating slowly at different speeds and depths. Minimal, product-first.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Product belongs to one or more Categories
Product has many Variants (size, colour, etc.)
Cart belongs to User, contains Product Variants
Order is created from Cart, belongs to User
Order has a Payment and an Address
Order has a Status (pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, returned)
Review belongs to User, written about a Product after Order
Wishlist belongs to User, contains Products
Promotion applies to Products, Categories, or Orders
Return belongs to Order, initiated by User
Notification belongs to User, triggered by Order status or price drop events

interaction_patterns: All MVP and Startup interaction patterns
AR try-on button pulses on eligible products — draws attention
Subscribe and save toggle on product detail — monthly saving shown instantly
Abandoned cart push notification — product thumbnail in notification
Low stock badge — only X left — creates urgency
Bundle savings badge — save 20% shown on bundle suggestion
Admin funnel chart — drop-off percentage on each step clearly labelled
B2B quantity input — volume pricing tier updates as quantity changes
Instalment amount shown per month clearly on checkout — reduces friction

layout.notes: Product photography is the entire UI. Every layout decision exists to surface product images. Minimal chrome — no clutter competing with the product.

avoid: Never use a white background card border around product images — full bleed only
Never centre product titles on cards — always left-aligned
Never show more than 2 lines of product title on a card — truncate with ellipsis
Never use a dropdown for size or colour selection — always use chips or swatches
Never hide the price — it must be visible on the card without tapping
Never use a quantity stepper smaller than 44px tap target
Never show out of stock variants as available — grey them with strikethrough
Never use generic stock photography — if no product image, show a branded category placeholder
Never put more than 4 items in a bottom navigation — home, search, cart, profile is the max
enforce: Add to cart CTA always sticky at bottom of product detail screen
Colour variants always shown as actual colour swatches — never dropdown
Size guide link always visible near size selector
Return policy always visible on product detail — never buried in footer
Cart item count badge always visible on cart icon
Out of stock state: grey image overlay, crossed price, 'Notify me' CTA
Product rating and review count always shown on product detail — never hidden
Checkout progress indicator always visible — step 1 of 3, etc.

empty_states.ui: Featured category banners full bleed. Bestsellers grid below. Never show personalised section until 3+ products browsed.
Shopping bag illustration. Message: 'Your cart is empty'. CTA: 'Start shopping'. Show 3 recently viewed products below if available.
Heart illustration. Message: 'Save items you love'. Instruction: 'Tap the heart icon on any product'. CTA: 'Browse products'.
Package illustration. Message: 'No orders yet'. CTA: 'Shop now'. Never show empty table.

loading_states.ui: Hero banner loads first — skeleton full width. Below: 2-col product grid with skeleton cards — image block top, 2 text lines below.
Image gallery placeholder top full width. Title and price skeleton below. Skeleton never taller than a typical product page. Variant chips skeleton visible.
Order summary visible immediately. Spinner on payment processing button only. Never full screen loader during checkout.

error_flows.trigger: Item sold out after adding to cart
error_flows.ui: Cart shows red badge on item: 'Now out of stock'. Checkout blocked until item removed. Option: 'Remove and continue' or 'Save to wishlist'.
Inline error below payment method. Specific reason if available: 'Insufficient funds' / 'Card expired'. Order not placed. Cart preserved. Retry without re-entering all details.
Error on address step: 'We don't deliver to this address yet'. Map shows delivery zone. Option to enter alternative address.
Inline error below code input: 'Code not valid' or 'Code expired'. Never remove the code field — let user try another. Show discount amount clearly when code is valid.

edge_cases.ui: Urgency label on card and detail: 'Only 1 left'. Never fabricate scarcity — only show when stock count is genuinely 1.
Colour selector scrollable horizontal. Size selector scrollable. Never collapse into a dropdown even with many variants.
Checkout available without account. Account creation offered after purchase — 'Save your details for next time'. Never force registration before purchase.
Push notification: '[Product] is now [price]'. Wishlist item shows 'Price dropped' badge with original and new price.
